A '''Sybarion gown''' was a [[Color/Legends|maroon]]-colored<ref name="AOTC" /> airy gown<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|supi|Supi}}</ref> that featured a diamond-shaped cutout below its low neckline.<ref name="AOTC" /> A Sybarion gown was worn by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Supi/Legends|Supi]], who often wore it while she did her duties as [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]].<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she wore the gown to a meeting of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] at the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]<ref name="AOTC" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="VD" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sybarion gown was first shown with the trailer for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Trailer">{{SW|url=video/episode-ii-trailer-clone-war|text=Attack of the Clones Trailer: Clone War &#124; Video}}</ref> released on [[March 10]], [[2002]].<ref name="TrailerRelease">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/article/2002/03/04/sneak-peek-next-episode-ii-trailer|text=A sneak peek at the next <nowiki>''</nowiki>Episode II<nowiki>''</nowiki> trailer|author=Brown, Scott|date=2002-03-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Entertainment Weekly|''Entertainment Weekly'']]|quote=On March 10, the latest two-and-a-half-minute tease for "Attack of the Clones" will hit screens|archivedate=20231127115801}}</ref> It was then first identified in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[April 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> The gown later made its first appearance in ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="AOTC" /> which premiered on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Supi was the first source to provide its capitalization,<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|supi|Supi}}</ref> which was left ambiguous in ''The Visual Dictionary''.<ref name="VD" />
